solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: European Community reversed regulation for "sky blue"

indicators.note: reversed tells us to read the abbreviation for the European Community backwards

parts.note: a regulation is a rule

explanation.surface: A Brussels directive dictating which shade of blue the sky is officially allowed to be.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerule is a rare poetic word for a sky-coloured, azure shade, as in cerulean.

clue.text: Among Anglicans chorus hum to disconcert poor creature

indicators.note: Among places the scrambled letters within the two letters standing for Anglicans

parts.note: CE is the ... of England, the Anglican ...

indicators.note: to disconcert is to throw into disorder, so the letters of chorus and hum are jumbled

explanation.surface: A church choir humming so badly that it unsettles some unfortunate creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to disconcert' is the anagram signal on chorus and hum; 'Among' sets the jumble inside the two letters for the Anglican church, splitting them at either end.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverbial phrase 'as poor as a church mouse' makes this animal the very image of a penniless being.

clue.text: Nervous unit is concerned about cable attached to damaged vehicle

parts.note: RE means concerning or about, as in business letters
a flex is an electric cable

indicators.note: damaged signals that the word for a vehicle is knocked out of shape and rearranged

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone fretting over a cable hooked up to a wrecked car.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflex arc is the nerve pathway producing a reflex, a basic functional unit of the nervous system.

clue.text: Beneficiary of a miracle is gull in Arizona? Just the opposite

indicators.note: in, as the clue first reads, would put the gull inside the state abbreviation
Just the opposite reverses the stated containment, so the state goes inside the bird

parts.note: Larus is the scientific genus name of gulls
AZ is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Arizona

explanation.surface: Someone blessed by a miracle turns out to be a seagull wandering the Arizona desert.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, 'in' would put the bird inside the state; 'Just the opposite' swaps the roles. The gull is its Latin genus name, which solvers may not know.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Gospel of John, Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead, so he received a miracle.

clue.text: Money from plays in church? On the contrary

indicators.note: in, read straight, would put the plays inside the church abbreviation
On the contrary flips the containment, so the church abbreviation sits inside the plays

parts.note: plays are dramas

explanation.surface: Raising cash by staging plays in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, 'in' would put the plays inside the church; 'On the contrary' swaps container and contents.
explanation.definitionFit: Drachmas were the currency units of Greece before the euro, so they are a kind of cash.

clue.text: Some satiric humour is outrageous

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark that a bit of satirical comedy goes too far.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'that's rich' means a remark is outrageous or hard to credit, an idiomatic sense.

clue.text: Player of stringed instrument has return of sickness at heart

parts.note: the core is the heart of something

indicators.note: return of means the word for sickness comes back, read from right to left

parts.note: ill can mean sickness or harm, as in 'ills'

explanation.surface: A musician who suffers a relapse of some heart complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' turns the sickness word backwards; 'heart' is read as its synonym, which comes first in the answer although last in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcangelo Corelli was a celebrated Italian Baroque violinist and composer.

clue.text: Phrygian king is mad, mad

indicators.note: the second mad, meaning crazy or wild, tells us to scramble the letters of is and mad

explanation.surface: A frantic insistence that some ancient monarch has lost his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'mad' looks like emphasis; the first is fodder, the second the signal, turning ISMAD into the king.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend King Midas of Phrygia turned everything he touched to gold.

clue.text: It is soundness of mind to include a third bit of carbolic to be hygienic

indicators.note: to include means the word for mental soundness wraps around the extra letters

parts.note: sanity is soundness of mind

indicators.note: third bit of picks out the third letter of the word carbolic

explanation.surface: Claiming it is sane to add a dash of carbolic soap for cleanliness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'third bit of carbolic' is R, the third letter; A and R go inside SANITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitary means promoting health through cleanliness, a close synonym.

clue.text: You sound very loud in zone 1 gallery

indicators.note: sound tells us to take the word as heard, which is the single letter

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like U
FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
I is taken here as a short form of in, the setter's loose abbreviation
the numeral 1 looks like the letter I

explanation.surface: Someone shouting in a numbered area of an art museum.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter takes 'in' as I, a loose abbreviation; FF is the musical mark fortissimo, and the numeral 1 gives the last I.
explanation.definitionFit: The Uffizi in Florence is one of the world's great art galleries.

clue.text: Relating to ticks, accountant has lowest emotional state in recession

parts.note: ACA, Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants, is a qualified accountant

indicators.note: in recession means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a nadir is the lowest point, here of mood

explanation.surface: An accountant sinks into deep gloom during an economic downturn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in recession' reverses NADIR to RIDAN. 'ticks' are the mites, not check marks or seconds.
explanation.definitionFit: Acaridan is the adjective for the Acarida, the order of mites and parasitic arachnids such as ticks.

clue.text: Archbishop's rule for monks is in error about very small item

indicators.note: about places the anagram around the word for a scrap
in error means mistaken or wrong, so the letters of for monks are jumbled

parts.note: an ort is a tiny scrap or leftover of food

explanation.surface: An archbishop's monastic rule turns out to be wrong about some trivial matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in error' is the anagram signal on 'for monks'; 'about' then wraps the jumble round the scrap so it sits after the opening M.
explanation.definitionFit: Archbishop John Morton's tax rule held that both lavish and frugal living proved ability to pay, a dilemma now named after him.

clue.text: Expressions of good health produced by small frankfurters Down Under

definitions.meaning: cheery toasts or farewells wishing someone well
in Australia, small cocktail sausages are known by this name

explanation.surface: Toasts raised over plates of little Australian sausages.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both cheery salutations and, in Australian English, little red cocktail sausages.

clue.text: Where Henry was lost among clothes thrown out?

definitions.text: Where Henry was lost among clothes thrown out?

indicators.note: was lost among says the letter for Henry goes missing from the clothes
thrown out signals the remaining letters are tossed and rearranged

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A king's garments flung about, and the king himself vanished among them.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking H from CLOTHES and rearranging gives the place where clothes are kept, so the whole clue also defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A closet is a cupboard for storing garments, the natural place to be lost among them.

clue.text: Drink without food can make one arrogant

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the drink surrounds the food

parts.note: to sup is to drink
tuck is British school slang for food, especially snacks

explanation.surface: Drinking without eating can make someone haughty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but means outside here. TUCK is British schoolchildren's slang for sweets and snacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Stuck-up is an informal synonym for snobbish or conceited.

clue.text: Profiteer when tourist acquires collections

indicators.note: acquires puts the word for collections alongside the tourist, joined on before it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
sets are collections
a tripper is a tourist on an outing

explanation.surface: A tourist accumulates souvenirs whenever possible, profiting as he goes.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset-stripper buys a company to sell off its assets for profit, a kind of profiteering.

clue.text: Patricide could perhaps be related to the care of children in America

definitions.text: related to the care of children in America

indicators.note: could perhaps be suggests the word may be reshaped into something else

explanation.surface: Musing on whether killing one's father might be linked to childcare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in America' flags the US spelling, without the A of British 'paediatric'.
explanation.definitionFit: Paediatrics is the branch of medicine dealing with children; the American spelling drops one vowel.

clue.text: In India one short man is in need

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
gent is a shortened form of gentleman

explanation.surface: In India, a small man is living in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigent describes someone poor and lacking necessities.

clue.text: Vitamin's manufactured from coccidia, innit?

indicators.note: manufactured from suggests the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A slangy claim that a vitamin is made from parasitic protozoa, isn't it?
explanation.definitionFit: Nicotinic acid, or niacin, is one of the B vitamins.

clue.text: In US twister's making new trouble after corruption is reciprocated

indicators.note: after places the new trouble behind the reversed corruption
is reciprocated means given back, so the word for corruption is turned round

parts.note: rot is decay or corruption
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: An American storm brewing fresh mischief after a scandal comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating windstorm, especially common in the USA, called a twister there.

clue.text: A variety of sources is needed to discover the King of Lydia

indicators.note: A variety of suggests a mixture, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A historian must consult many sources to learn about an ancient king.
explanation.definitionFit: Croesus was the fabulously wealthy sixth-century BC ruler of Lydia in Asia Minor.

clue.text: God's means of attack in Merchant Navy

indicators.note: in means the ammunition sits inside the naval abbreviation

parts.note: MN is the abbreviation for the Merchant Navy
ammo, ammunition, is a means of attack

explanation.surface: A deity's arsenal carried aboard merchant ships.
explanation.definitionFit: Mammon is the false god of riches and greed in the Bible.

clue.text: Heartless adolescent is shut up

indicators.note: Heartless removes the middle letters from the word for adolescent

parts.note: adolescent can mean immature, childish

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted teenager is locked away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' takes AT, the central pair, out of IMMATURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To immure is to wall in or confine someone, a synonym of imprison.

clue.text: See 1
Gold for mother and army people who act by routine

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
to can mean for, as in 'a toast to'
ma is mother
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Gold medals awarded to a mother and the army.
explanation.definitionFit: Automata are robots or people who act mechanically, without thought.

clue.text: See 11
Teacher's ill-mannered to retort about censor

indicators.note: about puts the reversed word around the censor
to retort is to turn back, so the word for ill-mannered is reversed

parts.note: rude means ill-mannered
Cato the Elder was Rome's famous Censor

explanation.surface: A schoolteacher is rude in answering back about a censor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to retort' reverses the word for ill-mannered, giving EDUR; 'about' wraps that round the Roman. Cato the Elder held the office of Censor and is known by that title.
explanation.definitionFit: An educator is someone who teaches, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Retreat of sheep by tree

parts.note: the ash is a tree
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: Sheep withdrawing to the shade of a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu religious retreat or hermitage.

clue.text: Everything possible with kosher cooking follows Torah primarily

indicators.note: follows puts the anagram after the initial taken from Torah
primarily picks the first letter of the word Torah
cooking suggests the letters are stirred up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Kosher cooking that follows the Torah and offers every possible dish.
explanation.definitionFit: 'The works' is an informal idiom for everything that comes with something, the full set.

clue.text: Recipient of Holy Communion in a hospital?

indicators.note: in places the Communion abbreviation within the letters for a hospital

parts.note: san, short for sanatorium, is a hospital
HC is an abbreviation for Holy Communion

explanation.surface: A patient taking Communion in a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recipient' looks like a communicant; it is a bin that receives ash.
explanation.definitionFit: An ash-can is an American dustbin, literally a container that receives ashes.
